notes.subject: שדוד / נשדנו / שדינו
notes.rationale: root שדד 'devastate' rings against שדה 'field' (שדינו) — devastation and fields sound alike; word-sound lost in Bambara

notes.subject: חלק / יחלק
notes.rationale: 'portion' and 'he divides' — same root: the portion is divided away

notes.subject: לשובב
notes.rationale: 'to the apostate/rebellious' (ASV) vs 'to him who returns/restores' (JPS: instead of restoring) — opposite readings of one root

notes.subject: an ka jamaa
notes.rationale: 'my people' rendered 'our people' inside the quoted lament; Hebrew keeps first person singular, bracketed shift

notes.subject: חלק … יחלק
notes.rationale: allotment language: measuring out portions and dividing fields by lot

translation: O don la, mɔgɔ bɛna masalɛ ta aw kan, ka kɔngɔ-kanben kɔngɔbenba, ka ko: “An jiginna bɛɛ! A y'<an ka jamaa> ka fɛn-yɛlɛma kɛ. A b'a bɔ ne la cogo di! Minnu bɛ bɛn, u de bɛ an ka forow labɛn.”
